speaker: Mr Leon Perera
text: asked the Minister for Transport what measures are in place to handle accidents where passengers fall onto MRT or LRT tracks in terms of (i) educating commuters on what they should do in the event of such an accident, whether they are victims or bystanders and (ii) the safety protocols that rail operators are required to conform to if such incidents occur.

speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
text: In the unfortunate event that a passenger falls onto the tracks, the passenger should immediately alert anyone nearby.

speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
text: This will simultaneously alert the station's Passenger Service Centre and the Line's Operations Control Centre.

speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
text: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) and the rail operators will do more to raise commuters' awareness.
